appearances.summary: What's Changed pplx-decider is a 27B decision model from Perplexity, fine-tuned from Qwen3.8-27B Continuing an OpenAI-compatible Responses conversation no longer fails when switching between models with and without thinking, or when the history contains another provider's compaction items Fixed streaming Responses requests where client tool calls (e.g. Codex with web search) could emit before open
